readiness_notes: The billing implementation, local typechecks, billing tests, mobile customer API tests, and store metadata validators pass.
Billing enforcement and purchases remain disabled in deployed environments until credentials, store products, and sandbox lifecycle tests are complete.

p0_blockers.title: Accept the updated Apple Developer Program Agreement
p0_blockers.why_blocking: App Store Connect does not permit the remaining in-app purchase and submission work until the Account Holder accepts the updated agreement.
current_evidence: App Store Connect shows an updated Apple Developer Program Agreement that requires Account Holder action.
exit_criteria: The Account Holder accepts the current agreement and App Store Connect no longer shows the agreement blocker.

p0_blockers.title: Create and install production billing credentials
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The Worker and RevenueCat cannot verify Apple or Google purchases or deliver account recovery email without production credentials and webhook secrets.
current_evidence: The RevenueCat Murmur project exists, but its Apple and Google apps are not fully connected.
No Apple in-app purchase key, Google Play service-account key, RevenueCat API keys, webhook secret, or Resend API key has been generated for this launch.
exit_criteria: Generate the minimum-scope Apple, Google, RevenueCat, and Resend credentials after explicit action-time approval.
Store credential material in 1Password and install only the required public values and Worker secrets in each environment.
Confirm RevenueCat-to-Worker webhook authentication and server-side customer verification in sandbox.

p0_blockers.title: Configure the Apple, Google, and RevenueCat product catalog
p0_blockers.why_blocking: Customers cannot buy Murmur Pro or credit packs until the exact products, prices, entitlement, offering, and packages exist and are linked across both stores and RevenueCat.
current_evidence: The source-controlled catalog and contribution-margin tests define the approved products and prices.
The matching App Store Connect, Play Console, and RevenueCat product records are not complete.
Google Play will not enable subscription or one-time product creation until a billing-enabled Android App Bundle is uploaded.
exit_criteria: Upload a signed internal-test Android App Bundle that declares the Google Play Billing permission.
Configure Pro monthly at USD 12.99, Pro annual at USD 124.99, and credit packs at USD 3.99, USD 10.99, and USD 31.99 with approved localized tiers.
Link the Apple and Google products to RevenueCat entitlement pro and offering default with the documented package identifiers.
Complete store review metadata, tax, availability, and subscription disclosures for CollabEZ FZE LLC.

p0_blockers.title: Complete Apple and Google billing sandbox tests
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The code is locally verified, but production release needs real store evidence for purchase, restore, renewal, expiry, refund, and metered balance behavior.
current_evidence: Local tests cover ledger idempotency, grants, reversals, reconciliation, account merge, and translation metering.
No completed App Store sandbox or Google Play licensed-tester lifecycle run is recorded for the new catalog.
exit_criteria: Record successful purchase and restore tests for each platform and product class.
Record renewal, cancellation, expiry, refund, refund reversal, duplicate webhook, reinstall, cross-device sign-in, and negative-balance behavior.
Prove billing enforcement can stay enabled while the purchase kill switch disables new checkout.

p0_blockers.title: Deploy and verify the staged production billing release
p0_blockers.why_blocking: The live Worker and mobile builds must use the verified production configuration before the paid offer can be released safely.
current_evidence: Production billing enforcement and purchase flags remain false.
The additive reconciliation migrations are applied to development and production D1, but no billing-enabled Worker revision has been deployed.
exit_criteria: Apply all additive D1 migrations and deploy the Worker with production secrets while purchases stay disabled.
Verify readiness, account recovery, entitlement reconciliation, metering, observability, and rollback controls live.
Release approved store builds in stages, enable purchases only after live proof, and verify the deployed revision.
